## Description

Fix reviewer finding: dual records/record_types catalogs in contract/project-design.json.

## Approach

1. Remove the top-level `record_types` key from contract/project-design.json; keep freeze fields and oracle-amendment only under `records`.
2. Update acceptance verify_commands (and any skill examples) that read `d['record_types']` to use `d['records']` instead — via parent store updates if needed; in the worktree, ensure tests/skills that hardcode record_types are fixed.
3. Re-run the contract shape asserts and skill consistency tests.
4. Do not reintroduce a full duplicate catalog.
record.subject: fix-contract-record-types
